name: worms-eye-jet-sky
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: an editorial fashion photograph shot from an extreme worm's-eye low angle, camera near the ground aimed straight up at the subject.
· GROUND: a vast flat periwinkle sky filling the frame with a huge passenger jet passing low overhead — underbelly, engines and landing gear detailed and looming, faint contrail streaks high up.
· SCALE: dramatic monumental perspective — the subject towers foreshortened and heroic, kept small against the enormous aircraft.
· LIGHT: flat cool overcast daylight, soft diffuse shadows, matte low-contrast rendering.
· PALETTE: muted cool tones only — dusty periwinkle blue-grey sky, aluminium silver-white, charcoal and near-black garments, a single note of warm skin.
· TEXTURE: subtle fine grain, slightly desaturated, restrained and moody.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
